title: Show time last updated/refreshed
line: The weather widget now shows when the current conditions were observed, and weather notices show when they end as well as when they start.
explanation: Every weather provider already reports when the current conditions were observed, but the widget never displayed it, so there was no way to tell how old the numbers were. Notices only had a start time in the data model, so the notices page could not say when a warning ends even though DWD and NOAA send that. The change shows "Observed at <time>" (with the date if it isn't today) under the current conditions, and adds an end time to notices, filled in by the DWD and NOAA providers and shown as a start – end range.

commits.message:
applets/weather: show observation time and when notices end

The widget never said how old the current conditions were, and notices
only showed when they start. Show the observation time under the current
conditions, and give notices an end time where DWD and NOAA provide one.

BUG: 523652

media.caption: Master, DWD München: current conditions with no hint of when they were measured
With the fix: "Observed at 7:00 PM" under the temperature
Master: the frost warning only shows when it starts
With the fix: the warning shows its start and end time

review.text: Shows data the providers already deliver: the observation timestamp under the current conditions, styled like 'Feels like', and an optional end-time role filled by DWD and NOAA. Providers without an end time look as before. It is minimal, follows the existing model and role pattern, and the media match the live DWD API values.
